Dynasty Backstories
What are your origins? What do you carry with you, and what are you here to prove?
The past might pay you a visit, but your choices remain your own.

For generations, your dynasty has lived by the same trade, its craft passed from parent to child and refined with every hand. The family name is trusted in the workshop, where skill speaks louder than words and results need little persuasion.

Your dynasty has long stood among the city's most respected families. Its name still opens doors, commands attention, and carries expectations. Generations of comfort may have softened its descendants, but prestige has a strength of its own.

Your dynasty remembers grander days — fuller coffers, finer company, and a name that carried further than it does now. Much has been lost, but not forgotten. The family still knows how the world of influence works, and perhaps it is only a matter of time before others remember too.

Your dynasty has been at odds with other families for longer than anyone can properly remember. Insults became grudges, grudges became retaliation, and somewhere along the way the feud became tradition. Whatever started it hardly matters now. What matters is making sure your side comes out on top.

Your dynasty has long been known for its devotion and close ties to the Church. Its faith has earned trust in the streets, respect in respectable circles, and a reputation few would question lightly. In a city where everyone has something to hide, being thought virtuous can be remarkably useful.

For generations, your dynasty has answered calls to war and returned with stories, scars, and a reputation for being difficult to break. Peace may suit them well enough, but discipline and battle-readiness are habits the family has never quite managed to leave behind.

Your dynasty has outlived plagues, fires, bitter winters, and more than a few funerals meant for someone else. Whatever hardship comes, its members have a stubborn habit of surviving it. Some call it strong blood. Others wonder whether so much survival is really luck at all.

Books, tutors, and inconvenient questions have always found a place in your dynasty. Its members are encouraged to study what others overlook and ask what others would rather leave unanswered. It has earned the family considerable knowledge — and a reputation for knowing when not to stop digging.

Your dynasty has spent generations entertaining crowded taverns, market squares, and anyone willing to stop and listen. Its members know how to hold an audience, read a room, and make strangers feel like old friends. Respectability may come and go, but a good crowd is rarely far away.
The family has never been particularly noble, religious, or principled. They survived generations by knowing when to change allies.

Your dynasty carries a name respectable company prefers not to mention too loudly. Scandals, accusations, and questionable associations have followed it for years, leaving few illusions about its reputation. But a bad name has its uses — especially among people who know the value of discretion.

Your dynasty has no ancient fortune to inherit and no famous name to lean on. What it has, it earned — through work, nerve, and a keen eye for opportunity. The wealth may be new, but its ambitions are not small, and the city's established families are beginning to take notice.
Generations of carefully arranged marriages have connected the dynasty to merchants, officials, clergy, and craftsmen throughout the city.
No past defines you, and no old reputation follows in your wake. Whatever story you leave behind begins here.
